project_yaml:

language: c++
primary_contact: "t-beu@users.sourceforge.net"
sanitizers:
  - address
  - memory
  - undefined
architectures:
  - x86_64
main_repo: 'https://github.com/tbeu/matio'

fuzzing_engines:
  - afl
  - honggfuzz
  - libfuzzer

FROM gcr.io/oss-fuzz-base/base-builder
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y make autoconf automake libtool-bin cmake
RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/madler/zlib.git zlib

RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/tbeu/matio.git matio
RUN git clone --depth 1 --branch hdf5_2_1_1 https://github.com/HDFGroup/hdf5.git hdf5
WORKDIR matio
COPY build.sh $SRC/
